name: WdProtectionType
description: Specifies the type of protection applied to the current document.

constants.name: wdNoProtection
constants.description: Do not apply protection to the document.

constants.name: wdAllowOnlyRevisions
constants.description: Allow only revisions to be made to existing content.

constants.name: wdAllowOnlyComments
constants.description: Allow only comments to be added to the document.

constants.name: wdAllowOnlyFormFields
constants.description: Allow content to be added to the document only through form fields.

constants.name: wdAllowOnlyReading
constants.description: Allow read-only access to the document.
